digest: The watcher starts overlapping intent reads without an in-flight bound; abort and disposal only limit subsequent polling.
finding: Stop polling starts unbounded concurrent persistence reads
counterEvidence: The aborted-signal guard and foreground launch check prevent further reads once cancellation is observed. Thus storage stalls do not inherently prevent foreground cancellation detection.
Disposal clears the interval, limiting future starts to the watcher's active lifetime. It does not bound outstanding reads before disposal.
recommendedAction: Permit only one outstanding intent read per watcher, while checking foreground launch cancellation before the in-flight guard. Add a deferred-read regression test covering repeated ticks and local cancellation before that read settles.
